{
  "name": "rf_xtal_cap_read_write",
  "confidence": "medium",
  "docstring": "Dispatches RF crystal trim read/set operations: mode 0 reads coarse/fine caps, mode 1 writes coarse xtal_cap, mode 2 writes fine xtal_cap to EFuse or flash, and returns packed cap/remain data.",
  "subsystem": "rf",
  "var_renames": {
    "a1": "action",
    "a2": "xtal_cap_value",
    "v2": "xtal_calib_src_flags",
    "v3": "use_efuse_xtal_calib",
    "v6": "coarse_cap_remain",
    "v7": "fine_cap_remain",
    "v8": "packed_fine_remain",
    "v9": "packed_coarse_remain",
    "v11": "flash_read_result",
    "v12": "packed_return_value",
    "v13": "saved_coarse_xtal_cap",
    "v15": "xtal_calib_status_byte",
    "v16": "efuse_coarse_field_result",
    "v18": "efuse_fine_field_result",
    "v19": "xtal_cap_value_echo",
    "v20": "xtal_cap_value_echo",
    "_frame": "cap_storage",
    "_frame.a1a": "packed_xtal_caps",
    "_frame.a3": "efuse_flash_word"
  },
  "struct_hints": [
    {
      "offset": 0,
      "meaning": "coarse xtal_cap byte"
    },
    {
      "offset": 1,
      "meaning": "fine xtal_cap byte"
    },
    {
      "offset": 2,
      "meaning": "EFuse/flash 32-bit calibration word"
    }
  ]
}
